notes.title: The iOS version of "Cellveillance" is launched globally today
notes.notes:
The iOS version of "Cellveillance" has been globally launched on June 19th!    Download address: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6742316613    Search for "Cellveillance" in the App Store to download and experience it.
